 Richland County woman charged in alleged Enterprise Rent-A-Car insurance fraud scheme 
 Insurance fraud (MGN) By WIS News 10 Staff Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 4:04 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google NOTE: The above video is a livestream of WIS featuring current newscasts, Soda City Living and Gray Media’s Local News Live. 
 COLUMBIA, S.C. (WIS) - A Midlands woman was arrested for alleged insurance fraud involving Enterprise Rent-A-Car on Nov. 5. 
 Courtney Harris, 34, was charged by SLED with allegedly presenting a false claim for insurance payment of $10,000 or more.
 According to the warrant, Harris knowingly made false statements to present an illegitimate insurance claim between October 19, 2025, and March 3, 2026. She claimed to police and Enterprise Rent-A-Car Rental Claims Services that she did not know the alleged victim. 
 The arrest was the second in an insurance fraud case involving Enterprise Rent-A-Car. Harris was implicated as a co-conspirator in a case involving Shante Bethel, who was charged with forgery of $10,000 or more and related charges in October 2026.
 Bethel allegedly sent a forged medical bill purportedly from MUSC Health Columbia. The false claim was also submitted for insurance payment to Enterprise Rent-A-Car Rental Claims Services, according to Bethel’s arrest warrant.
 Harris’s claim submitted to Enterprise Rent-A-Car totaled $223,176.77, as reported by the alleged victim. 
 Harris was taken to the Alvin S. Glenn Detention Center. 
 Neither Harris nor Bethel has been tried in court.
